description: Revoke an Anchor immediately by anchor_id. After revoke, the capability URL fails closed. Requires a bound active Seat in the same Space. Destructive. Not idempotent.

anchor_id.description: Anchor (share link) id returned by create_anchor.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A string you generate once per intended action (a UUID is good) and repeat on retry. A retry with the same key and arguments returns the first result instead of acting twice; the same key with different arguments is refused. Kept 24 hours.

name: revoke_anchor
title: Revoke Anchor
